_comment: Representative seed of real CARC/RARC codes mapped to the denial taxonomy. Production: replace with the full X12 Claim Adjustment Reason Code and Remittance Advice Remark Code tables published at x12.org/codes, keeping this JSON shape.

4.description: The procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used or a required modifier is missing.

11.description: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the procedure.

16.description: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s) needed for adjudication.

22.description: This care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits.

29.description: The time limit for filing has expired.

45.description: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.

50.description: These are non-covered services because this is not deemed a 'medical necessity' by the payer.

97.description: The benefit for this service is included in the payment/allowance for another service/procedure that has already been adjudicated.

109.description: Claim/service not covered by this payer/contractor. You must send the claim/service to the correct payer/contractor.

151.description: Payment adjusted because the payer deems the information submitted does not support this many/frequency of services.

204.description: This service/equipment/drug is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.

rarc.M25: The information furnished does not substantiate the need for this level of service.
rarc.N56: Procedure code billed is not correct/valid for the services billed or the date of service billed.
rarc.N115: This decision was based on a Local Coverage Determination (LCD). An LCD provides a guide to assist in determining whether a particular item or service is covered.
rarc.N130: Consult plan benefit documents/guidelines for information about restrictions for this service.
rarc.N179: Additional information has been requested from the member.
rarc.N386: This decision was based on a National Coverage Determination (NCD).
rarc.N479: Missing Explanation of Benefits (Coordination of Benefits or Medicare Secondary Payer).
